servinfo.title: Blind spot monitor function does not work normally

item.ptxt: Blind spot monitor system is controlled by blind spot monitor control module communicating with the following control modules through CAN communication. Before performing symptom diagnosis, check that no DTC is indicated in these control modules.
It is necessary to remove the rear bumper for visual inspection of the blind spot monitor control module.

condition.ptxt: Blind spot monitor function does not work normally

ps.ptxt: Blind spot monitor function is not in execution state
Vehicle running state that blind spot monitor control module is difficult to recognizes rear cross traffic

action.ptxt: Unload the vehicle, remove modification parts for vehicle’s height, rear bumper, etc. and replace with genuine parts.

ps.ptxt: Adhesion of water droplets, snow or contaminant on rear bumper around blind spot monitor control module

action.ptxt: Clean rear bumper or blind spot monitor control module surface.

ps.ptxt: Looseness, coming off or damage of rear bumper
Damage of blind spot monitor control module bracket or vehicle body
